senses.gloss:
मृश् मृश् (often confounded with मृष्), i. 6, Par. (in epic poetry also Ātm., Rām. 2, 62, 18).
 1. To touch, to stroke.
 2. To think, to consider.
 --With the prep. अनु अनु, To consider, Rām. 2, 11, 9.
 --With अव अव, Caus. To trouble, Bhāg. P. 4, 7, 48. []
 --With आ आ,
 1. To touch, Śiś. 9, 34.
 2. To destroy, Ragh. 9, 5 (Calc.).
 --Comp. ptcple. pf. pass. अन्-आमृष्ट, Untouched, Daśak. in Chr. 200, 1.
 --With पर्या परि-आ, To overpower, MBh. 4, 164 (with ष् instead of श्).
 --With परा परा,
 1. To stroke, Utt. Rāmac. 25, 14.
 2. To touch, Ragh. 3, 68 (Calc.).
 3. To seize, MBh. 4, 46.
 4. To seduce, Chr. 6, 7.
 5. To violate, Daśak. in Chr. 199, 11.
 --With परि परि,
 1. To stroke, Rām. 2, 10, 25.
 2. To seize, Rām. 2, 23, 5 (with ष्).
 3. To consider, Rām. 1, 2, 20.
 --With वि वि,
 1. To stroke, Rām. 2, 20, 32.
 2. To inquire, MBh. 3, 2680 (with ष्).
 3. To examine, Mālav. 11, 23.
 4. To reflect, Hit. 71, 2, M.M.; Bhāg. P. 6, 5, 10; Hit. iv. d. 97 (विमृश्य-कारिन्, One who acts [only] after due reflection). अ-विमृश्य, Without reflecting, Pañc. 238, 25.
 5. To perceive, Bhaṭṭ. 3, 7.
 --Caus. To examine, Pañc. i. d. 122.
 --With अनुवि अनु-वि, To reflect, Daśak. in Chr. 181, 15.
 --Cf. Lat. mulcere, probably, mulcare.

1. मृष् मृष् (often confounded with मृश्), i. 4, and i. 10, and † i. 1, Par. Ātm.
 1. To bear, to endure patiently, Man. 4, 217; Pañc. iii. d. 19; v. d. 67.
 2. To suffer, Utt. Rāmac. 71, 8.
 3. To let, Daśak. in Chr. 199, 10.
 4. To pardon, Man. 8, 313.
 --Comp. ptcple. of the pres. अ-मृष्यन्त्, अ-मर्षयन्त् (Johns. Sel. 54, 135), and अ-मृष्यमाण, Enraged.
 --Caus. To suffer, Hit. iii. d. 48.
 --Comp. ptcple. of the pf. pass. अ-मर्षित, adj. Impatient, angry, Rām. 4, 9, 13. दुर्मर्षित, i. e. दुस्-, adj. Incited, stirred up, MBh. 14, 2314.
 --With the prep. अव अव, To endure, Pañc. rec. orn.
 --With प्रत्यव [] प्रति-अव. To endure reluctantly, Daśak. in Chr. 185, 5.
 --With वि वि, To neglect, MBh. 3, 15441.
 --Cf. Goth. marzjan (Caus.); O.H.G. marrjan; A.S. myrran.
† 2. मृष् मृष्, i. 1, Par. To sprinkle.

मृषा मृषा (an old instr. sing. of 1. मृष् + अ, properly, ‘With pardon,’ ‘I beg your pardon’), adv.
 1. Falsely, Man. 3, 53.
 2. Uselessly.
 --Comp.
मृषार्थक मृषार्थक, i. e. मृषा-अर्थ + क, n. An absurdity, an impossibility.

मृषोद्य मृषोद्य, i. e. मृषा-वद् + य,
 I. adj. and sbst. Lying, a liar.
 II. n. Falsehood, Utt. Rāmac. 104, 2.

मृष्टि मृष्टि, i. e. मृज्, मृश्, and मृष्, + ति, f.
 1. Cleaning.
 2. Preparing food, Man. 3, 255.
 3. Touching.
 4. Sprinkling.
